rows.grounds: object of worship; accusative singular feminine of devī
instrumental of means; compound indicating offerings beginning with fragrance
instrumental specifying the mantra employed in recitation
adverb specifying the number of recitations

items.question: What ritual worship and recitation procedure must be performed with the root-mantra?
premises: The goddess must first be worshipped with fragrance and other offerings.
The recitation must be performed using the root-mantra alone.
The prescribed recitation is to be done once.
items.inference: The required ritual procedure consists of worshipping the goddess with offerings and then reciting once using only the root-mantra.
uncertainties: The specific mantra or text to be recited is implied by context rather than named explicitly.
items.plain_english: Having worshipped the goddess with fragrance and other offerings, one should recite once using only the root-mantra.
